book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Hayqoppe Yesusa Denth
Wogga wontta maaladora maccassati ba giigsida shittoza ekkidi Yesusa woththida duufozakko bida.
Shuchchayka duufoza doonappe genderidi dizayssa be7ida.
Gido attiin giddo gelidi Yesusa ahaa demmontta aggida gishshas,
isttas hanzaazi dhayiin istti tollu gidaashe qoppontta xolqettiza may7o may7ida nam7u asati istta achchan eqqida.
Maccassatikka keehi babbidi duge biitta xeellishin, «He asati paxidi dendidayssa hayqeththata giddon ays koyeetii?
Izi dendides! Haan baa. Qasseka izi Galilan dishe inttes kase ay gidaakko ane qopite.
Asa Nay nagaranchchata kushen aadhdhi imettanaassinne kaqettanaas, hayqoppeka heedzdzanththo gallas dendanaas bessees» giidi yooti woththides.
Maccassatikka he wode kase izi gida qaalaa akeekida.
Maccassati duufosoppe simmidi hessa ubbaa Yesusa kaalliza tammanne issinetassinne haratas yootida.
Hessaka Hawaaretas yootiday Magdale gizasoppe yida Maaramonne Yohaano geetettizaarira Yaaqoobe Maaramonne isttara issife diza hara maccassata.
Gido attiin isttas maccassati yootidayssi agumo misatiin ammanibeettenna.
Gido attiin Phexroosi woththan Yesusa duufokko gakki hokkidi duufoza giddo xeellishin iza ahaza xaaxida may7oy xalla dizayssa be7idi keehi malalettishe baso simmides.
Bana Kaalliza Nam7atas Yesusa Qoncceth
He gallas iza kaallizaytappe nam7ati Yerusalaameppe tammanne issi kilo metire haakkiza Emahoose geetettiza katama beettes.
Bishe istti he wode hanida Yesusa hayqo gishshas ba giddon haasayetteettes.
Istti haasayettishin Yesusi isttako shiiqidi isttara issife bishin,
istti iza erontta mala istta ayfey oykettides.
Yesusi istta, «Hayssi oge hemettishe intte intte giddon haasayettizayssi aazee?» gides. Isttika dagamara modhettishe sitti gi eqqaa gida.
Istta giddofe issoy Qaliyopha geetettizayssi zaaridi, «Ha mata gallassatan Yerusalaamen hanidayssa erontta imaththa asi nena xallaa?» gides.
Izikka isttas zaaridi, «Aazi hanidee?» giin istti qasse zaaridi, «Xoossa sinththaninne asa ubba sinththan oosoninne qaalan mino nabe gidida Naazirete Yesusa gishshassa» gida.
Izakka qeeseta halaqatinne daannati hayqo pirdas aaththi immidanne kaqqida.
Nuni gidikko, « ‹Isra7eele wozzanay iza› giidi ufayettidosishin harappeka hessi haniin qasse hach heedzdzanththo gallassa.
Qasse nu giddofe issi issi maccassati nuna keehi malalisida; isttika maalado wonttara gede iza duufokko biidi,
iza ahay beettontta ixxiin yiidi izi paxa dizayssa isttas yootiin Kiitanchchata be7idayssa nuus yootida.
Nuuppeka issi issi asati iza duufokko biidi maccassati gida mala be7ida attiin Yesusa demmibeettenna» gida.
Izikka isttas, «Intteno wozinan woththonttaytoo! Intte wozinay kase nabeti yootidayssa ammananaappe takkidaytoo!
Xoossafe kiitettidayssi ha metoza ekkanaassinne gede ba bonchchoso gelanaas bessennee?» gides.
Museppenne nabetappe doommidi Geeshsha Maxaafatan iza gishshas xaafettidayssa isttas lo7eththi yootides.
Istti ba bizaso matida wode Yesusi aadhdhi bizaa misatides.
Isttika qasse, «Gadey qammiza gishshas nunara aqa» giidi iza keehi woossiin isttara aqanaas gelides.
Isttara issife maaddan uttidi uketh ba kushen oykkidi isttas menththi menththi immides.
He wode istta ayfey doyettiin iza gididayssa erida; izikka istta ayfeppe geemmides.
Isttika, «Nu yishe oge bolla dishin nuna haasayssidi Geeshsha Maxaafatakka qonccisidi nuus gelanaashe yootiin nu wozinay tama mala xuugettibeennee?» giidi issoy issaara haasayettida.
Heerakka dendidi Yerusalaame simmi bida; tammanne issinetinne isttara issife dizaytikka issi bolla shiiqi dizayta demmida.
Isttika ba giddon issoy issaas, «Goday tumu dendides! Simoonaska beettides» gida.
Iza kaallizaytappe nam7ati oge bolla hanidayssanne Yesusi ukeththaa menththi menththi immida wode istti wostti eridaakko isttas yootida.
Yesusi Bana Kaallizaytas Qoncceth
Hessa gishshas istti ba giddon haasayettishin Yesusi istta giddon eqqidi, «Saroy inttes gido!» gides.
Gido attiin istti moytille be7idaa misatiin keehi dagammida.
Izikka isttas, «Aazas daro qoppeetii? Aazas intte wozinara sidheetii?
Ta kushetanne ta tohota haa xeellite; tanakko; qasseka tana oykki be7ite; tana intte be7izayssa mala moytilles ashoynne meqeththi deenna» gides.
Hessa gi simmidi ba tohotanne ba kusheta istta bessides.
Isttika ufayssa daroppenne malaleteththafe dendidayssan buro ammanontta dishin Yesusi, «Hessan aykko mizaazi dizee?» giidi istta oychchides.
Isttika mole xiixa issi bars izas immida.
Izikka ekkidi istta sinththan mides.
Izikka, «Inttenara ta diza wode, ‹Muse wogan nabetaninne yeththa Maxaafatan ta gishshas xaafettidayssi wurikka polettanaas bessees› gaada ta inttes yootida ta qaalay hayssako» gides.
He wode Geeshsha Maxaafata istti erana mala wozina isttas doydes.
Isttaskka, «Kirstoosi waaye beyana; heedzdzanththo gallas hayqoppe dendana geetetti xaafettides.
Yerusalaameppe doommidi ubba deres nagarappe simoynne maaroteththi iza sunththan yootettana.
Intteka hayssas markkatta.
Tanikka ta Aaway immida ufayssaa inttes yeddana; intte qasse wolqqa bollafe may7ana gakkanaas Yerusalaame kataman takkite» gides.
Pude Salo Yesusa Buus
Hessafe guye istta ekkidi Bitaaniya geetettizaso kezides. Ba kushetakka denththidi istta anjjides.
Istta anjjishe isttafe shaakettidi pude salo bides.
Isttika izas hokki goynnida; keehi ufayettishe Yerusalaame simmida.
Ubba wode Xoossa Keeththan Xoossaa galatishe gam7ida.
